reviews.text: A very kind, helpful and precise doctor, as well as very knowledgeable, she manages to explain things in a clear and simple way.

Heartfelt thanks to Giaconella Veterinary Clinic and Dr. Roberto Giaconella

Our experience with Giaconella Veterinary Clinic began last year, when we brought our beloved Pocci for a visit. Dr. Roberto Giaconella identified a perianal mass and clearly explained the need for treatment.

Unfortunately, we were unable to proceed at that time, and for about a year and a half we cared for Pocci daily, administering medications and trying to keep the situation under control. Over time, however, the mass had grown significantly, and others had appeared in the same area.

When we returned to the clinic, Dr. Giaconella explained to us that we could no longer delay and that surgery would be necessary, addressing the perianal masses, neutering, and even a small growth that had appeared near his eye.

At that time, in addition to our concerns for Pocci, we were dealing with a particularly difficult personal situation. Dr. Giaconella showed us an understanding and sensitivity we will never forget. He reassured us, making us feel understood and supported, and allowed us to finally face this journey with greater peace of mind. For us, it was a gesture of great humanity.

On August 12th, we brought Pocci to the clinic for surgery. Before the operation, we met Dr. Aniello Raimondo, an anesthesiologist, whom we greatly appreciated for his professionalism and, above all, his sincerity. He explained to us very clearly the risks associated with anesthesia, without hiding anything from us. It wasn't easy listening to those words and leaving our Pocci in the operating room, but we trusted them.

After about two hours, the long-awaited news finally arrived: the surgery had gone well and we could go and pick up Pocci. ❤️

Today, we can still hold him, caress him, and have him by our side, and for that we will always be deeply grateful.

We sincerely thank Dr. Roberto Giaconella, not only for his professionalism and expertise, but above all for his humanity, availability, and understanding. In a difficult time, he cared not only for the patient, but also for the family he had before him.

Sincere thanks also to Dr. Aniello Raimondo for the professionalism, honesty, and attention he showed before, during, and after the surgery, and to the entire staff at the Giaconella Veterinary Clinic for carefully accompanying us on this journey.

For us, you were more than just veterinarians. You gave Pocci a chance and us the opportunity to continue to have him by our side.

We will never forget it.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Thank you for Pocci. ❤️

With love and gratitude,
Gianluca and Ilaria, Pocci's family 🐾

This clinic saved my dog's life, and I can't say they're not good. But since I got my new dog, I've noticed that the prices for checkups are always different, and I wonder how that could be possible. The first time I went on a Sunday for an emergency, but always with an appointment, I paid €50, and they told me it was because it was Sunday. I went later during the week and still paid €50, and today, when I had a checkup every time, I paid €35. It's not entirely clear what the prices actually are.
I'm noticing that there's a lot of profit being made from these animals, even though you can't really charge someone €35 or even €50 for a three-minute visit.
My dog ​​is being treated by Dr. Rivolta, and I can't comment on her professionalism and expertise, but this animal trafficking is really making me realize that the love for these four-legged friends of ours is completely out of place.

I went on Sunday for a check-up and paid €50. I went during the week and paid the same, and then I went on Wednesday and paid €35. So I can't figure out how much this check-up actually costs. This clinic seems to be setting its prices to suit its own convenience.

An excellent experience with the Giaconella Clinic. My dog ​​Miele has been cared for by them since he was a puppy, from vaccinations to the extraction of his overlapping canine teeth. A month ago, he had acute gastroenteritis, but thanks to the team's care, the outpatient stays with IVs, and the right therapy, he's back to being my Miele of old.

Special thanks to Dr. Rivolta, always knowledgeable, thorough, and helpful, to the doctor who performed the ultrasound, and to the wonderful nurses, whom Miele adores.

I highly recommend her!
I've always had a good experience with cats and dogs. I just recommend booking with them. They take care of a wide range of animals and also have a surgical department.
Absolutely to be avoided if you love your furry friends, terrible experience as in this clinic there is a lot of superficiality especially in the operating room

This morning I took my dog ​​in for stitches, a procedure they recommended and described as very mild. Unfortunately, it wasn't. The dog died of cardiac arrest despite specific heart tests that revealed no cardiac abnormalities. I hope there was no incompetence, which will be revealed by the autopsy and the true causes.
That's all.

I had a video consultation with Dr. Veronica Giaconella, recommended by a friend who has been seeing her for some time. The consultation was about my cat's epilepsy. The doctor was very attentive, dedicated the necessary time, and prescribed specific medications to manage future seizures. I'm very satisfied with the visit: she was professional, available (she even gave me her cell number for further information), and serious. Definitely recommended.
Very helpful, reliable, very empathetic staff!!!

Hi, I'm Massimo. I have a 4-month-old Maltese puppy, and a very dear friend recommended taking our SPILLO to the GIACONELLA clinic. We called to make an appointment for a check-up, the third vaccination, and then she recommended a fecal analysis. Without knowing the cost of everything, we avoided it so as not to appear too "SHORT-ARMED," also because, like all of us who have a pet living in the family, I believe we do everything we can to make them feel good. With this in mind, we went and Dr. RIVOLTA examined our SPILLO. She was very professional, calm, and attentive, and I must say that during the examination, we were also thrilled with Dr. RIVOLTA's attention. But... unfortunately, when we went to pay, we honestly remained a little silent so as not to cause any controversy. For the check-out, the third vaccination, and the fecal analysis, the guy at the cashier charged us €135. But, as I said at the beginning, we do everything for our animals. We left with the professionalism of Dr. RIVOLTA, and with the doubt of having paid a little (A LOT). But that's not the problem where I sincerely would like an explanation because it's a fact that PERSONALLY I will go to the clinic and someone will have to give me explanations. About what? About the fact that after an hour or two after we left, we received a phone call from Dr. RIVOLTA where she apologized and these exact words "... MRS. DI BATTISTA (my wife) I APOLOGIZE BUT YOU PAID 75 EUROS MORE. I'M SORRY BUT DON'T WORRY, WHEN OUR PUPPY BRINGS ME THE PIN STOPS, YOU LEAVE THE STOPS AND THE BOY WILL GIVE YOU THE 75 EUROS BACK. DON'T FORGET TO ASK THE BOY AT THE CHECKOUT FOR THE MONEY..." As soon as I hung up the phone my words "FANTASTIC, GOOD PEOPLE STILL EXIST". But it was just a false hope of mine to believe that... The reason? My wife brought the stool to the clinic on the afternoon of April 13th, and what happened? Everything the doctor had told us on the phone—I remember she was the one who called us—was actually bullshit, forgive me. The guy at the register told my wife that it wasn't possible to refund the money and even that the stool tests hadn't been paid for and that only those had cost 55 euros. So my wife is a calm person and doesn't want to argue, especially since the clinic was crowded, and without arguing, she listens to everything the guy at the register tells her. In fact, the guy even dared to be sarcastic about the whole situation; he gave us the SERESTO equivalent to a cost of 40 euros, so in the end we had made a profit by only paying 135 euros. SO, GIVEN ALL THIS, I HONESTLY DON'T LIKE BEING MOCKED, AND EVEN MORE THAT, ACCORDING TO THE GUY, I GAINED MONEY FROM IT. SO, I'LL FIRST MAKE IT CLEAR THAT AT THIS POINT, IT'S NOT ABOUT THE MONEY, BUT A QUESTION OF RESPECT FOR CUSTOMERS AND A LACK OF PROFESSIONALISM IN TALKING TO THE CUSTOMER IN TWO DIFFERENT WAYS. I BELIEVE THAT IF DOCTOR RIVOLTA CALLED TO APOLOGIZE FOR PAYING TOO MUCH, I FIND IT UNPROFESSIONAL THAT THERE IS A PERSON AT THE CHECKOUT WHO TELL YOU "... IT'S THE DOCTOR WHO MADE A MISTAKE, IN FACT SHE MADE MONEY WITH THE "SERESTO". SO IN FRONT OF A GROUP OF PEOPLE WHO WORK IN DIFFERENT BUT CONNECTED DEPARTMENTS, I DO NOT FIND THE STRUCTURE PROFESSIONAL. AND IT IS FOR THIS REASON, AND I REPEAT, AT THIS POINT, I AM NOT INTERESTED IN MONEY, BUT OUT OF RESPECT FOR EVERY CLIENT, I WOULD LIKE THE OWNERSHIP OF THE STRUCTURE TO BE ABLE TO GIVE ME SOME ANSWERS TO EVERYTHING THAT HAPPENED TO ME. AND I REPEAT THIS WITHOUT TELLING ANYONE." "fairy tales" BECAUSE I DON'T WANT MY INTELLIGENCE AS A PERSON TO BE MOCKED. ALSO BECAUSE I CAN PUBLISH IT WITHOUT ANY PROBLEM BUT I DON'T WANT IT TO COME TO THIS, I HAVE MADE SEVERAL COST REQUESTS REGARDING WHAT I HAVE DONE IN YOUR STRUCTURE. SO I'M GIVING ONE STAR AND CALMLY WAITING FOR YOUR REPLY.
